title: Featured
subtitle: Populated demonstration Map
body: The Map stays visible. A short coach enters and Featured is emphasized. Example pins exist only for the tour.
note: Map at your location; Ocean Park fallback.

title: Friends
subtitle: The map changes with the source
body: Switch the real filter to Friends and visibly change the example places.
note: Places saved by people you follow.

title: More
subtitle: Open, move through, close
body: Open the actual More panel. Automatic playback scrolls through it, returns to the top, and closes it on Next.
note: The coach does not require choosing a filter.

title: Search
subtitle: Point to the real search field
body: Explain Search without bringing up the keyboard or requiring a search.

title: Plus
subtitle: A brief introduction to saving
body: Point to + and explain saving/importing in a short block. The import form stays closed.

title: Pin meanings
subtitle: Solid Check In · dotted Wanna
body: Show the actual pin legend. Line style communicates status; color is not the visited/wanted distinction.
note: Replaces the forced N15 save lesson.

title: The ending
subtitle: Stay over the same Map
body: A subtle material layer keeps the Map beneath the connection line. Skip works immediately; automatic playback returns to the usable Map.
note: “Life happens between us.” is review copy; six seconds is the current proposal.

title: Nearby Places
subtitle: Only when the person opens +
body: Stationary handwriting, a circle and an arrow point to Nearby Places. Black in light mode, white in dark. Next, about five seconds, or a real tap dismisses it.
note: “Your nearby places will show up here.”

title: Feed
subtitle: Only on a voluntary Feed visit
body: An optional native scroll reveal uses up to twenty available activity groups, slows down and settles into the normal Feed. Dragging interrupts it. Short/empty feeds use their real content.
note: The review account is a local fixture. No real social activity is invented.

title: Lists
subtitle: One block, three purposes
body: Share recommendations, organize your own places and keep imports together. No forced creation.
note: Four localized starter lists remain a content proposal; this pass does not seed user data.

title: Check In / Wanna
subtitle: On the place profile itself
body: Stationary handwriting points to the actual two actions. The buttons remain usable while the annotation is visible.
note: Places you’ve been / places you want to go.
